# Youth soccer lineup generator: equal playing time, no kid benched twice in a row

> Free youth sports lineup generator for volunteer coaches. Equal playing time, nobody benched twice in a row, goalkeeper turns shared, subs planned per period. Soccer, basketball, hockey and more. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
